_about: Every achievement sticker. Edit, rebuild, ship. Pay (xp and coins) comes from rarityPay unless a sticker has a reward with its own xp / coins; a reward can also give a free shop item such as decal:crown. A sticker with rule null is designed but cannot be detected yet. See docs/stickers.md.

groups.name: First steps
groups.blurb: Everyone gets the first two inside their first week.

groups.name: Pace
groups.blurb: About being quick. Measured against your own times and the board.

groups.name: Challenges
groups.blurb: Weekly office challenges. The top ones double as bragging rights.

groups.name: Clean driving
groups.blurb: Rewards tidy laps over fast ones, so slower drivers have a way to shine too.

groups.name: Explorer
groups.blurb: Try new tracks, cars and games.

groups.name: Drifting
groups.blurb: For the sideways crowd. Needs the game to report slip angle.

groups.name: Funny and funky
groups.blurb: The silly ones. Some are a joke, some are a dare.

groups.name: The hard ones
groups.blurb: Long-haul stickers. Most drivers will never see these.

groups.name: The Green Hell
groups.blurb: For people who know the Nordschleife. Counts only on the Nordschleife: the Nürburgring in Assetto Corsa EVO, and Nordschleife in Assetto Corsa.

stickers.name: First lap
stickers.how: Finish your first timed lap.

stickers.name: Ten laps
stickers.how: Ten timed laps on one track.

stickers.name: Century
stickers.how: 100 timed laps in total, on any track or car.

stickers.name: Local
stickers.how: 50 laps at one track. Also unlocks the Home track backdrop.

stickers.name: Personal best
stickers.how: Beat your own best time on any track.

stickers.name: Purple sector
stickers.how: Set the fastest sector on a board.

stickers.name: On the pace
stickers.how: Finish a lap within 1% of a track record.

stickers.name: Record breaker
stickers.how: Hold the fastest lap on 5 different tracks at once.

stickers.name: Entered
stickers.how: Set a time in a challenge.

stickers.name: On the podium
stickers.how: Finish in the top 3 of a challenge.

stickers.name: Crown
stickers.how: Take the crown on any board.

stickers.name: Reigning
stickers.how: Hold a track record for 7 days. Also unlocks Gold numerals.

stickers.name: Giant killer
stickers.how: Beat the top time on a board while sitting in its bottom half.

stickers.name: Tidy lap
stickers.how: A lap with no track-limit cuts.

stickers.name: Five clean
stickers.how: 5 clean laps in a row.

stickers.name: Smooth operator
stickers.how: 20 clean laps in a row.

stickers.name: Spotless
stickers.how: Every lap clean through a whole challenge.

stickers.name: Rule bender
stickers.how: Cut the track on 5 laps in a row and still stay within 2% of the track record every time.

stickers.name: Tourist
stickers.how: Drive 3 different tracks.

stickers.name: World tour
stickers.how: Drive 10 different tracks.

stickers.name: Garage queen
stickers.how: Drive 5 different cars.

stickers.name: Switch hitter
stickers.how: Set a lap in 2 different games.

stickers.name: Rematch
stickers.how: Beat a colleague's time.

stickers.name: Streak
stickers.how: Drive on 5 days in a row.

stickers.name: Lunch break
stickers.how: Set a lap between 12 and 2. Secret until you do.
stickers.hint: Hidden. Something to do with midday.

stickers.name: Photo finish
stickers.how: Finish within 0.010 s of another driver.
stickers.hint: Hidden. Something to do with very close racing.

stickers.name: Sideways
stickers.how: Hold a slide for 2 seconds.

stickers.name: Skid marks
stickers.how: Slide a combined 1 km across all your laps.

stickers.name: Tyre fryer
stickers.how: One slide lasting 10 seconds without spinning out.

stickers.name: Drift king
stickers.how: Spend more than half a lap sideways and still finish it.

stickers.name: Handbrake hero
stickers.how: Start a slide with the handbrake and finish the lap clean.

stickers.name: Spinning top
stickers.how: Spin the car all the way round and still finish the lap.

stickers.name: Scenic route
stickers.how: Finish a lap 50% slower than your best. Enjoy the view.

stickers.name: Participation trophy
stickers.how: Finish last in a challenge. It still counts.

stickers.name: Early bird
stickers.how: Set a lap before 8 am. Coffee first.

stickers.name: Night owl
stickers.how: Set a lap after 7 pm. Secret until you do.
stickers.hint: Hidden. Something to do with the evening.

stickers.name: Lucky seven
stickers.how: A lap time that ends in .777.

stickers.name: Mirror lap
stickers.how: A lap time that reads the same backwards, like 1:42.241.

stickers.name: Dead heat
stickers.how: Match another driver's time on the same board to the millisecond.

stickers.name: Wrong way round
stickers.how: Stop dead facing backwards mid-lap, then carry on and finish it.

stickers.name: Slow and steady
stickers.how: Ten laps in a row within 0.2 s of each other.

stickers.name: Friday feeling
stickers.how: Set a lap after 4 pm on a Friday.

stickers.name: One more go
stickers.how: After your slowest lap of a session, drive five more straight away.

stickers.name: Moonwalk
stickers.how: Cross the finish line of a lap or stage facing backwards.

stickers.name: Marathon
stickers.how: 500 timed laps in total.

stickers.name: Hat trick
stickers.how: Win three challenges in a row.

stickers.name: Untouchable
stickers.how: 50 clean laps in a row.

stickers.name: Perfectionist
stickers.how: Three laps within 0.1% of your own best time on one track.

stickers.name: Completionist
stickers.how: Earn every other sticker in the book.

stickers.name: Green Hell
stickers.how: Finish a timed lap of the Nordschleife.

stickers.name: Ring regular
stickers.how: Ten timed laps of the Nordschleife.

stickers.name: Sub eight
stickers.how: Lap the Nordschleife in under 8:00.

stickers.name: Sub seven
stickers.how: Lap the Nordschleife in under 7:00.
A Nordschleife lap time that ends in :20.832, like 7:20.832. The circuit is 20.832 km long.
stickers.hint: Hidden. How long the Ring is, on the stopwatch.
